what.text: This page follows refugees from Gambia living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1686 Gambian refugees in Germany, 25.1% of all refugees from Gambia.
Germany is the largest host of Gambian refugees, followed by Italy, the United States and France.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Gambia, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2005 and 2018 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 167 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
